name: community-ethryn
summary: Ethryn nerfs (a community member, 21 Oct): six heirloom numbers (Knight's Prayer Book, Dawncleave, Brawler's Aegis, Oathsworn Mask, Elysian Warbrew, Matriarch's Halo)
research: docs/recon/community-build-heroes.md (Ethryn nerfs, a community member, 21 Oct)

assets.why: Ethryn, Knight's Prayer Book (LMB heirloom): the armor from Talon Strike hits stacks up to 4 times (Feb 6). The heirloom's max-stacks effect plays at the new cap, since it asks this effect for its limit.
Ethryn, Knight's Prayer Book tooltip: up to 4 stacks (the text has the number written in).

Ethryn's passive heirlooms: Dawncleave, each Pummel stack makes the enemy take 7 % more damage (Feb 9 %); Brawler's Aegis, the Pummel stun deals 30 bonus damage (Feb 40); Oathsworn Mask, the cooldown reduction from Pummel stuns stops at 33 % (Feb 45 %; still +3 % per stun). The tooltips show these values by themselves.
Ethryn, Oathsworn Mask: the mask's 'maxed' look shows from 33 % cooldown reduction, the new cap (Feb 45 %, which the heirloom alone could no longer reach).
Ethryn, Elysian Warbrew (LMB heirloom): Talon Strike's bonus damage is 2 % of her current health (Feb 2.5 %). The tooltip shows the value by itself.
Ethryn, Matriarch's Halo (Shift heirloom): Ironclad Slam heals her 10 % of her missing health per enemy hit (Feb 12 %). The tooltip shows the value by itself.
